last_summary: Replication Watch run 5 — gear 1 (no quota error, no gear-2). +3 validations, each traced to a real source and none duplicating an existing Yard entry; library_feed.json rebuilt cleanly (BUILD_EXIT 0), practical.validations 30 -> 33, all counters verified no-regress. (1) MAGNETO-CULTURE — a Belgrade group (Institute of Physics Belgrade + Institute for Biological Research "Siniša Stanković") takes pre-sowing static-magnetic-field seed treatment OUT of the growth chamber and into a cabbage FIELD: 1 h at 350 mT -> +24.8% head weight, +22.7% plant weight; 100 mT -> +16.9%/+18.3% (EPJ Special Topics, online 21 Dec 2025). Filed medium on the specific result, LOW on the general claim: the largest multi-site field test in this literature is NULL (Minnesota Agricultural Experiment Station 1975/76 — five crops, four locations, four replicates, treated vs untreated same-lot seed adjacent: no significant advantage; wheat 40.6/40.7 bu/ac), and modern effect sizes spread ~25% (field) / ~78% (Sci Rep 2026 soybean vigour, lab) / ~200% (2026 safflower) — the spread is the finding. (2) BIODYNAMIC — INBIODYN Geisenheim 18-year field trial (complete block, 4 field replicates, Riesling, organic vs biodynamic vs integrated, 2006-2023; Agronomy for Sustainable Development 46:13, 12 Feb 2026, open access, doi 10.1007/s13593-025-01079-2): biodynamic indistinguishable from organic across almost every parameter (only significant diff = LOWER leaf P); org -16.7% / bd -14.3% yield vs integrated, gap closes 8-9 yr after conversion; both flip positive in hot dry vintages (org +2.3%, bd +9.0%). HIGH confidence — organic and biodynamic share soil, cover crop, weeding, N supply and rootstock, so the delta IS the preparations, and it is nil. Fifth long-term trial on a rail (Raupp-König 1996 / DOK 27-yr 2024 / Rienth 2023 / Spoerk Gabriel 2026 / this) that now reads: no average yield effect, only a sign that flips with conditions. (3) VORTEX/IMPLOSION — first validation in the Schauberger-lineage domain, and it is a negative: a 2026 CFD + model-boat test of Schauberger's claimed levitating/energy-generating vortex engine traces an apparent 25%-efficiency propulsion result to water ejected under the vortex (closing the vortex bottom killed it) and finds heat-driven vortices give no net extra rotation — filed LOW-CONFIDENCE, SINGLE-SOURCE, UNCONFIRMED (vendor page; no authors, institution, dates or paper), with mainstream gravitational vortex turbines as the counterweight (they work, at ordinary efficiency, Cp ~0.31 baseline). BUILD NOTE for the fleet: build_library_feed.py writes library_feed.json and THEN exits non-zero at _bake_live_stats() when index_shards/manifest.json is absent (bake_stats.py FileNotFoundError) — the feed survives so the Yard is safe, but a lane trusting the exit code will read the rebuild as failed and may restore a stale feed; worked around by materialising index_shards (clean exit 0 on re-run). Never-regress guards held correctly: library.translations 144 (translations/ is absent from the repo — the guards are why that is safe), latest_finds 286, latest_translations 132 unchanged, declassified 102; aflinks_docs 96,750 (index_shards present).
